title: 100 Days My Prince
overview: Lee Yool falls off a cliff and nearly dies in an attempted assassination. He loses his memory, and wanders for 100 days under a new name and personality. During this period, he meets Hong Sim, head of the first detective agency in Joseon.

title: Because This Is My First Life
overview: Two housemates get married for financial convenience, but discover nothing is simple when it comes to demanding in-laws — or facing their growing bond.

title: Chocolate
overview: Brought together by meaningful meals in the past and present, a doctor and a chef are reacquainted when they begin working at a hospice ward.

title: Christmas Flow
overview: An unlikely Christmas romance blossoms between a famous rapper and a tenacious journalist. But can they make it work despite their differences?

title: Dash & Lily
overview: Opposites attract at Christmas as cynical Dash and sunny Lily trade messages and dares in a red notebook they pass back and forth around New York City.

title: First Love
overview: Young, free and madly in love. As teenagers, the world was their oyster—but, as adults, their lives seem dimmer, like a very important piece is missing.

title: From Me to You: Kimi ni Todoke
overview: Nicknamed "Sadako" for her spooky appearance, high schooler Sawako begins to break out of her shell when she befriends popular boy Kazehaya.

title: From Me to You: Kimi ni Todoke
overview: With her gloomy demeanor, Sawako has a hard time fitting in. But when an outgoing classmate approaches her, life takes a turn for the better.

title: Girls from Ipanema
overview: A 1950s housewife goes to Rio de Janeiro to meet up with her husband, only to learn he's deserted her, but decides to stay and open a bossa nova club.

title: Home for Christmas
overview: 30-something Johanne navigates romance and family drama during the festive season, juggling exes and new relationships in her search for connection.

title: Hotel Del Luna
overview: When he's invited to manage a hotel for dead souls, an elite hotelier gets to know the establishment's ancient owner and her strange world.

title: I Am Married...But!
overview: After a meet-cute ends in a whirlwind romance, a couple must learn to navigate the messy reality of married life that's nothing like a fairy tale ending.

title: I Hate Christmas
overview: A nurse who is happily single the rest of the year is sick of being shamed for being alone at the holidays, so vows on December 1 to find someone to take home for Christmas.

title: Is Love Sustainable?
overview: After her mother dies, Kyoka moves in with her father, Rintaro, who begins to obsess over finding spouses for himself and his daughter.

title: It's Okay, That's Love
overview: From mere co-talkshow guests to being off-screen roommates? Things get steamier and awkward between a psychologist and novelist in their entanglement.

title: Like Flowers in Sand
overview: Struggling to find success, a former wrestling prodigy finds himself ready to quit until he reencounters an old friend who reignites his passion.

title: Love, Life & Everything in Between
overview: This black humor pan-Arabic anthology series is about love in general – and relationships in particular.

title: Made with Love
overview: To save the family business, ambitious chef Luka must team up with newcomer Dennis when he joins her mother's restaurant. The only catch? She hates him.

title: Meet Yourself
overview: Grieving the premature death of her closest friend, a despondent young Chinese woman quits her job to fulfill the friend's dying wish of visiting an area in southern China. What began as a three-month recuperative stay in a village far from the madding crowd gradually reveals the potential of life-changing camaraderie, romance, and purpose.

title: At Eighteen
overview: A misunderstood loner is drawn out of his shell after transferring to another high school, where he comes across new ordeals -- and first love.

title: My First First Love
overview: Due to various personal reasons, a group of Yun Tae-o’s friends move into his house, where they experience love, friendship, and everything in between.

title: My Holo Love
overview: Unexpected love finds a lonely woman when she forms a connection with a humanlike hologram who looks exactly like his prickly creator.

title: Once Upon a Small Town
overview: Against his wishes a veterinarian from the big city relocates to the countryside, where he meets a policewoman, a town insider with a friendly secret.

title: One Spring Night
overview: When Lee Jeong-in and Yu Ji-ho meet, something unexpected happens. Or it just may be that spring is in the air -- and anything is possible.

title: Replacing Chef Chico
overview: When a head chef falls into a coma, it's up to his devoted sous-chef to keep their Filipino fine dining restaurant from closing down.

title: Reunited Worlds
overview: Although born in the same year, two childhood friends end up being 13 years apart because they have aged surprisingly at different places (worlds) for some strange reason. Now Eom Hyeon Soo is a 31-year-old woman but Sung Hae Sung is still a 18-year-old boy. Cha Won Yooung is a chef also interested in Eom Hyeon Soo.

title: Reverse 4 You
overview: One sister foretells the future, and the other controls time. When a promised love seems doomed to tragedy, the pair sets out to change fate itself.

title: Rookie Historian Goo Hae-Ryung
overview: The story takes place at the beginning of the 19th century. Goo Hae-Ryung is a historian who tries to fight gender stereotypes as her work is often looked down on. She meets Prince Yi Rim.

title: Say I Do
overview: In this reality show, couples overcome obstacles to celebrate their love in surprise dream weddings designed by three experts in less than a week.

title: Secret Garden
overview: A wealthy young man and a poor stunt woman fall for each other, but when their souls swap they soon learn how different their two worlds are.

title: The Full-Time Wife Escapist
overview: A series of events leads single, 25-year-old Mikuri Moriyama and 36-year-old Hiramasa Tsuzaki to marry as a cover.

title: The Last Empress
overview: In an alternate-reality South Korea, where a constitutional monarchical system prevails, Oh Sunny, a musical actress, becomes the empress of the country. Thus begins a dispute for power in the royal palace. Nothing is what it seems, and Oh Sunny is ready to fight until the end to uncover a mysterious homicide within the royal palace, fighting to protect those she loves the most and obtain happiness.

title: The Light in Your Eyes
overview: Time manipulation comes with a steep price for a young woman, who becomes 78 years old overnight after using a mysterious watch.

title: The Potato Lab
overview: A potato researcher with 12 years of experience who is working on a secret project and a newly appointed eccentric director go head to head before falling for each other in a sweet office romance.

title: The Secret Life of My Secretary
overview: When a telecom executive develops face blindness, he mistakes his secretary for a wealthy heiress -- which she allows to get out of hand.

title: Tuiskoms
overview: After a series of misfortunes, Fleur — mourning a deep loss — takes her daughter and returns to her hometown in search of a renewed sense of purpose.

title: Typhoon Family
overview: Depicts the struggles of small and medium-sized businesses and their families who face the 1997 IMF crisis head-on.

title: Violet Evergarden
overview: The war is over, and Violet Evergarden needs a job. Scarred and emotionless, she takes a job as a letter writer to understand herself and her past.

title: What the Love! with Karan Johar
overview: With help from celebrity guests and a glam squad, filmmaker Karan Johar mentors six singletons through their personal struggles as they look for love.

title: Wok of Love
overview: Chef Seo Poong was once a star chef and worked at the best Chinese restaurant. His popularity faded and he eventually wound up working at a small, failing Chinese restaurant. Meanwhile, Doo Chil-Seong is the owner of a building. He is an ex-gang member and he was in jail for 5 yers.
